item.title: The Harness Is the New Operating System
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. The model supplies capability. The harness decides what that capability becomes. 1. One number first# DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, one set of weights. Run it through eight harnesses on DeepSWE v1.1 and the top score is 74.2 for mini-SWE-agent, the bottom 65.5 for OpenCode. Eight point seven points, same model name. The control sits at the other end.
